observations.text:
You see a garden wicket.
The lower rail has buckled against its post. Two
sound lengths will brace the hinges and let the
closed wicket swing.
Repair: 2 salvaged timber. Composition: Wood.

Timber rails span a hinged gap. Sound hinges let
the wicket open and close; damaged ones can be
braced with two salvaged timber. The longer path
around remains open. Breaking the rails leaves a
permanent opening. A drawgourd bed lies north of
this shelter wall. Its ripe shell carries water;
keep its seed for the prepared bed. A loose pallet
in the supply cellar can provide timber if
dismantled. The path around the west end stays open.
